decisions.reason: The standalone USB regulator powers the complete shared 3.3V rail, so moving the SK6812 LEDs onto that rail necessarily adds them to its powered loads.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The LEDs are now powered from 3.3V instead of 5V. At 3.3V supply the SK6812 data threshold drops to 2.31V, which the ESP32 3.3V output satisfies directly, so no level shifter is needed. The tradeoff is that 3.3V is slightly below the SK6812 datasheet minimum (3.7V), but it works reliably at indicator brightness levels.

AXP2101 remains the normal-operation source covering all system loads; moving the LEDs between downstream voltage rails does not change that power-path requirement.
The source does not change any sensor-board input, external sensor connector, signal assignment, or connector count.
The LED supply and direct data drive decision does not change USB D+/D- connectivity, enumeration, or the programming-port role.
